name: audit-ledger-reconcile
title: Reconcile the stale sd-audit-repo ledger against current HEAD
description: All 44 findings in .trellis/audit/ledger.md carry status: open, but spot-checks show several are demonstrably shipped (A-009, A-020, A-026, A-038, A-039) with matching archived tasks. The status field was never written back on merge, so no consumer -- including the autonomous work loop -- can tell which findings are real work. Re-verify every finding against its own recorded evidence at current HEAD, write back an accurate status with a verification note, and leave a ledger whose open set is the genuine remaining local backlog.
